<!-- generated by scripts/scrape.py -->

Grief weavers master the most famous aspects of the Shadow Plane: its propensity to create blasted shades of ruined places, slain creatures, and destroyed objects.

**Lost Heirloom (Ex):** At 2nd level, the grief weaver finds a shadow copy of a destroyed or lost item of great significance from a distant material world. The copy is twisted and possibly not even recognizable by the owners of the original, but it can still unlock power. The grief weaver can use the item like an occultist's implement with one point of mental focus invested per two shadow weaver levels. The grief weaver use the item's base focus power and adds the occultist spells of the item's school to his list of perspective spells. At 12th level, the grief weaver collects a second lost heirloom.

This ability replaces silhouette.

**Lost Shade (Su):** At 4th level, the grief weaver gains the friendship or service of a shade, an echo of a creature slain or lost on the Material Plane. The shade functions as a spiritualist's phantom, treating the shadow weaver's spiritualist level as his class level – 3.

This ability replaces piercing glimpse, energy duality, and weave matter.

**Weave Reality:** The grief weaver has access to the following weave reality option.

- **Weave Afterlife (Su):** At 3rd level, the grief weaver can channel negative energy as a cleric of his shadow weaver level by spending a use of weave reality. The save DC is Wisdom-based, as normal for weave reality options. He gains Command Undead as a bonus feat (even if he doesn't meet the prerequisites) and can only use this energy only to command undead. This weave reality option replaces luminous duality.

**Avid Learner:** A grief weaver can learn necromancy spells with avid learner, but not divination spells. This ability alters avid learner.
